description: Non-class shared record types (src/include/types/): each type, the evidence for it, the units that pass it to each other as their first argument (units) and the units whose view of their first argument matches this record header and no other record or class header on 3+ fields (layout_units); see docs/TYPES.md.

ResourceSelection.evidence: the selection-dialog record of the resource/selection helpers (apply_, choose_, commit_, confirm_, copy_, finalize_, poll_, refresh_, resume_resource_selection, config/names.json); units pass it to each other as their first argument

SubcommandPacket.evidence: the 6x subcommand packet, first argument of the handlers in subcommand_handler_table_8c2ed3dc (src/data/tables_8c2ed3dc.c); the u16 at +2 is the entity id the handlers pass to lookup_low_id (0xffff = none, below 0xc a client slot); only handlers that read nothing past this header use it

TimerRecord.evidence: the timer record of advance_timer_8c25bf48 (ticks at +0x24, kind at +0x38); units pass it to each other as their first argument

ViewParameters.evidence: the interpolated view-parameter record of interpolate_view_parameters (target0-3 / current0-3 / steps / elapsed); units pass it to each other as their first argument
